notes: Known internal inconsistencies in the paper rules. Each entry is a governance proposal: the winning resolution becomes a new version on the source entries. Resolved entries are kept (status resolved, weight 0) as history so the reasoning survives. Open entries are the FIRST votes the community should run.

entries.name: Printed creature hits disagree with the Rule 14 life formula

versions.notes: Detected by recomputing round_half_up(sum(stats)/10) for every card. The JSON currently stores the PRINTED value in data.life; the engine must pick one source of truth.

data.description: Rule 14 Part B: life = sum(stats)/10 rounded. Five creature cards print a different hit count.

proposed_resolutions.text: Engine derives life from stats at load time; data.life becomes a cached, non-authoritative field. New versions of the five creatures set life to the formula value.
Printed hits are deliberate design (e.g. Tangle Spider is fragile but strong). Add an optional data.life_override to creatures; Rule 14 gets a new version: 'unless the card prints otherwise'.
Keep the printed hits and adjust each creature's stats so the formula matches (rebalance script proposes the minimal stat delta).

entries.name: Razorfin Abolisher stats sum to 30, species rule says 40

data.description: Card prints 5; 5; 20; 0 (4 hits). The concept states every playable race has sum(stats) = 40 and Rule 14 gives 4 life only for 40. 30 would give 3 life.

proposed_resolutions.text: Treat it as a typo: Vitality 15 (sum 40). Matches the +Space adept flavour (high Matter) and keeps 4 life.
Treat it as a typo: World 15 (sum 40).
Keep 30 as a deliberate weak-but-adept character; new version with life 3 and a compensating property proposed by the rebalance script.

entries.name: Two paragraphs numbered Rule 0 and a late Rule 25 all describe setup

data.description: Rule 0 (tileset) and Rule 0 (character deck) share a number; Rule 25 re-states the tileset deployment with more detail (player-count sizes, entry-point order by Will).

proposed_resolutions.text: rule_0_setup v1.1.0 merges all three; rule_25 marked superseded (weight 0). Chosen.

data.description: Acquisition/trade, Life and Adjacency are all 'Rule 14'.

proposed_resolutions.text: Keep one entry rule_14 with Parts A/B/C so cross-references to 'Rule 14' in the paper stay valid. Chosen.

entries.name: Rule 21 says 'rounded up at mathematical principle' but its example rounds 4 down to 0

versions.notes: Resolved on 2026-10-19: round-half-up (0.5 -> 1, 0.4 -> 0), not ceiling. Engine formula recorded in battle_system_core.resolution_math.

data.description: 'Rounded up' would make 4 points = 1 damage, contradicting Example 2 in the same rule.

proposed_resolutions.text: Interpret as standard rounding at the nearest multiple of 10. Chosen.
Interpret literally as ceiling; rewrite Example 2.

versions.notes: Checked on 2026-10-19: the three Golem variants (10;5;9;0 / 10;9;5;0 / 9;5;10;0) all total 24; the three Elementals (5;5;20;0 / 5;20;5;0 / 20;5;5;0) all total 30. No change needed; recorded so the check is not repeated.
